name: hcapp_addEditReceipt
description: Creates or updates an HC.Receipt record for an event expense. Mode is determined by whether @receiptId already exists in HC.Receipt — if found, performs an UPDATE; otherwise inserts a new row. Passing FFFFFFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFFFFFFFFFF as @reimbursedBy clears all reimbursement fields (un-reimburse). Passing a valid @reimbursedBy hasher ID sets ReimbursedOn to the current timestamp and copies ReceiptAmount to ReimbursedAmount. After a successful write, delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to return refreshed event admin data.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for token validation.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic auth token. Validated by HC6.ValidateAppAuth (SP number 43). Auth failure returns errorType=11.

parameters.name: receiptId
parameters.description: Receipt to update. NULL or the null-UUID (00000000-...) triggers insert mode — a new UUID is generated internally. If the UUID is not found in HC.Receipt, also falls through to insert mode.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Required. NULL or null-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode=1243, errorType=12).

parameters.name: receiptShortDesc
parameters.description: Short description of the expense. Empty string normalised to NULL. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value (COALESCE pattern).
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is NVARCHAR(500); table column is NVARCHAR(255). Values between 256 and 500 chars will be silently truncated by SQL Server on insert/update.

parameters.name: receiptAmount
parameters.description: Amount of the expense. Negative values normalised to NULL before auth. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value (COALESCE pattern).

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Optional free-text notes on the expense. Empty string normalised to NULL. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value.

parameters.name: reimbursedBy
parameters.description: Hasher who reimbursed the expense. Null-UUID (00000000-...) normalised to NULL (keep existing). FFFFFFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFFFFFFFFFF is the clear-reimbursement sentinel — sets @clearReimbursement=1, nulls out all reimbursement fields. Any other non-null UUID triggers auto-population of ReimbursedOn=GETDATE() and ReimbursedAmount=ReceiptAmount.

parameters.name: reimbursedOn
parameters.description: Reimbursement timestamp. Accepted directly as DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — no brittle string CAST (fixed vs HC5). Values before 2000-01-01 normalised to NULL. Overridden to GETDATE() when @reimbursedBy is set to a real hasher ID.

parameters.name: reimbursedAmount
parameters.description: Amount reimbursed. Negative values normalised to NULL before auth. Overridden from Receipt.ReceiptAmount when @reimbursedBy is a real hasher ID. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value (COALESCE pattern).

parameters.name: reimbursedNotes
parameters.description: Notes on the reimbursement. Empty string normalised to NULL. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value.

parameters.name: imageUrl
parameters.description: URL of the receipt image. LEN < 20 normalised to NULL (fixed from HC5 DATALENGTH). On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is NVARCHAR(1000); table column is NVARCHAR(500). URLs between 501 and 1000 chars will be silently truncated by SQL Server on insert/update.

parameters.name: receiptsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed through to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData. NULL is coerced to 'ignore' before delegation. All other syncEventAdminData watermark params are hardcoded to 'ignore'.

parameters.name: removed
parameters.description: Soft-delete flag. -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). 1 = removed. On UPDATE, NULL keeps existing value (COALESCE pattern).

rowsets.name: WriteEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always returned as the first rowset. success=1 on success; success=0 on auth failure, validation failure, or unhandled DB error. errorCode and errorType are NULL on success.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success. 1243 = null/empty eventId; 1943 = unhandled DB error. Auth error codes come from HC6.ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error type code. NULL on success. 11=auth; 12=param; 13=not found; 14=removed; 15=business; 19=db.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on any failure path (auth, validation, or unhandled DB error). Not present on success — rowset 1 on success is the first rowset from hcapp_syncEventAdminData.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID for this error instance.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error type code matching the WriteEnvelope errorType.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code matching the WriteEnvelope errorCode.

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData
rowsets.description: On success, rowsets 1+ are the full output of HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData (multiple rowsets). See that SP's contract for column definitions. The receipts rowset is refreshed using the caller-supplied @receiptsUpdatedAfter watermark; all other watermarks are 'ignore'.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Receipt — when @receiptId is non-null and found in HC.Receipt (within transaction)
INSERT HC.Receipt — when @receiptId is null, null-UUID, or not found in HC.Receipt (within transaction)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on validation failure (null eventId), unhandled CATCH error
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — delegation after commit, outside TRY block; returns multiple rowsets for event admin data refresh

codeSmells.issue: @imageUrl parameter width exceeds table column width
codeSmells.detail: @imageUrl is NVARCHAR(1000) but HC.Receipt.ImageUrl is NVARCHAR(500). Any URL longer than 500 characters will be silently truncated on INSERT or UPDATE by SQL Server (or raise a string-truncation error depending on ANSI_WARNINGS setting).

codeSmells.issue: @receiptShortDesc parameter width exceeds table column width
codeSmells.detail: @receiptShortDesc is NVARCHAR(500) but HC.Receipt.ReceiptShortDesc is NVARCHAR(255). Values between 256 and 500 chars will be silently truncated or raise a truncation error.

The all-F UUID (line 120) is a magic sentinel value used to trigger clearing of all reimbursement fields. This is an unusual and undocumented-in-parameters convention that callers must know about. Carried forward from HC5. Consider replacing with an explicit @clearReimbursement BIT parameter in a future version.

codeSmells.issue: Negative sentinel values for numeric parameters
codeSmells.detail: Lines 69, 71: negative @reimbursedAmount and negative @receiptAmount are normalised to NULL as a sentinel for 'no value'. This is an implicit contract that callers must know — negative expense amounts are not representable. Consider using nullable parameters instead.

codeSmells.issue: Sync delegation runs outside the transaction and outside TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Lines 194-205: EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData is called after COMMIT and outside the TRY block. If the delegation fails, the receipt write has already committed and the caller receives no sync data — but also no error envelope. The error from the inner SP propagates directly to the caller as a raw SQL error, bypassing the HC6 error envelope pattern.

Line 68: @removed = -1 is normalised to NULL (keep existing). The HC6 pattern prefers nullable parameters over sentinel magic values. Low severity because this is consistent with HC5 behaviour and the mobile caller is already built around it.

Line 164: CostCategory is always inserted as 0. There is no @costCategory parameter, so callers cannot categorise an expense at creation time. If category management is ever needed, this will require a breaking change.

breakingChanges: @reimbursedOn type changed from NVARCHAR(50) to DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — callers that previously sent a date string must now send a typed DATETIMEOFFSET value
TRY/CATCH and transaction wrapping added — HC5 had neither; error behaviour on insert/update failure is now consistent and enrolled in the HC6 error envelope
DATALENGTH replaced with LEN for @imageUrl length guard — functionally equivalent for NVARCHAR; no caller impact
Success envelope rowset (WriteEnvelope) added as rowset 0 — HC5 had no success envelope; callers must consume rowset 0 before the syncEventAdminData rowsets
Delegation updated from HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData
